services.title: Product Procurement
services.desc: We arrange physical products according to customer specifications, quantities and project requirements through our sourcing network.

services.title: Custom Order Fulfillment
services.desc: We coordinate each approved customer order from procurement through preparation and fulfillment according to the quotation and agreed requirements.

services.title: Regulatory Compliance
services.desc: Orders and shipments are coordinated subject to applicable legal, customs, carrier, and destination-country requirements.

services.title: International Shipment
services.desc: After an order is prepared, Arseen Enterprises LTD coordinates international shipment through appropriate independent logistics providers.

steps.title: Submit Requirements
steps.desc: Provide your product specifications, quantity, destination and fulfillment requirements.

steps.title: Receive a Quotation
steps.desc: We review availability and provide a written quotation covering all order and shipping details.

steps.title: Approve & Pay
steps.desc: Review and accept the quotation, then pay Arseen Enterprises LTD for the approved order.

steps.title: Procurement
steps.desc: We coordinate procurement of your requested products through our sourcing network.

steps.title: Order Preparation
steps.desc: The order is inspected, consolidated, prepared and packaged for international shipment.

steps.title: Shipment & Tracking
steps.desc: We coordinate shipment and provide tracking information through to delivery.
